'''Jingyue''' is a researcher found at the '''Research Institute''' above Starward Riseway in Lahai-Roi. He can be with his colleague, '''Adonis''', who is coaching an '''Intern'''.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Jingyue:''' Scientific research? In theory, it's simple. Form a hypothesis, design the test, collect the data, write the paper, publish...
:'''Adonis:''' That's the ideal scenario.
:'''Intern:''' So... what's the not-so-ideal scenario?
:'''Adonis:''' Form a hypothesis, design the test, collect data while dodging [[Void Storms]]. Find the results are insignificant. Tweak the parameters. Discover an outlier. Spend three months chasing ''that'' ghost...
:'''Intern:''' That sounds really hard... But then you get to have your work published, right?
:'''Adonis:''' Then you propose a ''new'' hypothesis.
:'''Intern:''' ...What?
:'''Jingyue:''' ...Will you stop traumatizing the intern?
{{Dialogue End}}
